resolution.summary: The stipulation sets a total penalty of $1,800 and states that the respondent has paid it.

citations.quote: I have paid the amount of the penalty described above.

response.summary: In the signed stipulation form, the respondent statement acknowledges the violations and states that the outstanding reports have been filed and the penalty paid.

citations.quote: I acknowledge that the violation(s) of the Political Reform Act described above have occurred

items.summary: In a streamline Stipulation, Decision and Order (FPPC Case No. 2024-00544), the Fair Political Practices Commission's Enforcement Division and Gipson stipulated that nine behested payment reports (Form 803) for 2023 payments to The Council of State Governments West were filed late, with a total penalty of $1,800.
items.title: FPPC stipulation for late behested payment reports
